title: CutRight v2 pack signature (v1)
description: Detached signature over a pack manifest or release lock. The signature covers every file entry, the compatibility declaration and the manifest_hash. Algorithms are limited to BLAKE3+Ed25519 and SHA-256+RSA-PSS-3072 to avoid surprise runtime dependencies.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. Algorithms outside this list are invalid for release packs.

key_id.description: Stable identifier of the public key that verifies this signature.

signed_at_ns.description: Nanosecond unix timestamp when the signature was produced.

digest.description: BLAKE3 hash of the canonicalised signed body (manifest body + sorted file entries + compatibility declarations).

files.description: True iff the signature covers every entry in the manifest's files array.

compatibility.description: True iff the signature covers the compatibility declaration.

manifest_hash.description: True iff the signature covers the manifest_hash field.
